end.parentNote: Parth practised using one mark for each object and matching marks to objects to find what is missing or extra. Asha revisited the mix-up about making extra marks for a large object and used the rule “one object, one mark”; matching the marks back to the objects still needs more practice. At home, place a few small items in a row and have Parth touch each item once while making one matching mark.
